title: Phase 3 Payload — Planning & Tasking
description: Payload when phase=3, status=ok (FR-014..FR-016). Strict, linear, dependency-ordered tasks; review criteria integrated per task, not appended.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each task independently verifiable; names its acceptance condition (FR-015). Carried into the Phase 5 verification gate (FR-032).

speck_review_criteria_addressed.description: Which review criteria this task addresses (FR-016).

depends_on.description: seq numbers this task depends on; defines the linear order.
